thread:
maria_sales: FYI Orchid Systems legal asked for SOC2 + ISO excerpts, a signed pen-test letter, and confirmation we can keep request logs for 90 days during the POC. Theyre evaluating Dedicated vs Hosted and want a clear note on any onboarding fees for a 30-day trial.

devin_pre_sales: Thanks. Quick checklist: 1) SOC2 summary (redacted) 2) Controls matrix CSV 3) ISO 27001 scope statement excerpt 4) pen-test attestation 5) network diagram + sample VPC/CIDR config. Do we have a single package we hand out?

sara_security: We maintain a standard compliance packet. For ISO we share the scope excerpt and our ISMS contact. Pen-test attestation is not the full report but a signed letter stating a third-party external test was completed within the last 12 months + remediation status. We will not share full raw vuln data without an NDA.

maria_sales: Orchid asked if we can sign a short one-page pen-test letter and whether legal needs anything special to sign it.

sara_security: Legal will need the NDA before we attach vendor details. We can prefill the letter and mark the vendor name and date fields for legal sign-off. I can provide the prefilled PDF. ETA this afternoon.

ops_infra: On Dedicated POC costs: there is an operational setup charge for private networking and KMS binding. For a small single-pool POC we usually quote a one-time setup of ~$3k and then hourly instance costs. Hosted trial with credits = no onboarding fee. If they need guaranteed capacity and 90d logs we recommend Dedicated + log retention add-on which increases monthly cost. For a 30-day POC, expect ~ $3k setup + usage.

devin_pre_sales: Can we offer a temporary exception to 90d logs on Hosted for the POC? Customer insists 90d is an audit requirement for their reviewers.

sara_security: Hosted default retention is 30 days. We can enable 90d for Hosted only for enterprise customers with an addendum to the agreement and logging add-on. For a short POC, we can do a temporary extension under an MSA amendment, but legal will want to codify retention and deletion timelines.

maria_sales: Orchid also wants staging access for their infra team to validate inbound/outbound IPs and test SAML SSO flows. They prefer an SFTP drop for evidence upload.

ops_infra: We prefer presigned S3 uploads + scoped IAM role for staging. If they need SFTP, we can provide a managed upload endpoint but it requires ticketing and manual lifecycle cleanup. Presigned example we provide: ```aws s3 presign s3://redwood-stage/orchid/poc-evidence.zip --expires-in 172800```

sara_security: When we hand over artifacts, add a manifest (SHA256) and optionally a watermark on PDFs. For non-repudiation we recommend a signed manifest file and include a statement in the packet: "Files delivered are hashed; manifest signed by Redwood Security."

devin_pre_sales: Good. Can someone compile the packet and a short procurement note that answers: onboarding fee, can we do 90d for POC, any network egress commitments, and what artifacts require NDA? Ill send to Orchid with a proposed call time.

artifact-bot: Uploaded "orchid_poc/1769994800/" (5 files) -- https://storage.internal/redwood/orchid_poc/1769994800

ops_infra: I'll put together a delta spreadsheet (Hosted vs Dedicated) with a sample small-PoC estimate. Need expected concurrent RPS and average token length. If Orchid can't provide, use conservative defaults: 5 concurrent, avg 512 tokens, 95p 1024.

maria_sales: I'll ask Orchid for RPS and also confirm whether procurement will sign an MSA amendment for 90d retention.

sara_security: I'll prefill the pen-test attestation and mark the NDA/legal fields. Will include the language: "Redwood Inference attests to an external penetration test performed on [DATE] by [VENDOR], summary attached; full report available under NDA."

devin_pre_sales: Please add a one-sentence example for procurement about egress: "Network egress is billed per cloud provider rates; Dedicated pools do not change carrier egress rates but may move egress zone depending on VPC placement."

ops_infra: Adding that. Also note: if they request IP-based allowlist we may need a short maintenance window for peering config.

maria_sales: Thanks team. I'll circulate the draft packet and the procurement blurb in the thread when ready. Call tentatively tomorrow 10am PT.
